** Feature **
In as much detail as possible, describe your idea. Note that depending on the feature, it may or may not be added to the mod.

** Reasoning **
Explain why you would like this in SimplyMore. Be sure that the idea you are suggestion makes more sense to be in Simply More instead of Simply Swords, as we do not want to stray too far from the base mod.
